name: Trading Capacity 3 Code
definition: Specifies the role of a trading party in a transaction.

RISP.name: Riskless Principal
RISP.definition: Trading as a riskless principal, ie, the order to buy(sell) has been simultaneously offset by an order to sell (buy) with another party.

PROP.name: Proprietary
PROP.definition: Trading for its firm. The transaction affects the firm's own account, not that of its customers.

AGEN.name: Agent
AGEN.definition: Trading as Agent on behalf of a customer.

OAGN.name: Other Agent
OAGN.definition: Acting as an agent for a party other than a customer.

PRAG.name: Principal Agent
PRAG.definition: Acting as an agent for some executions and principal for others in the same transaction.
